item.title: St. Regis Singapore completes ‘sophisticated’ transformation

item.title: La Vie expands international footprint
item.description: La Vie Hotels & Resorts has signed two new management agreements marking an entry into the Philippine marketplace and solidifying the group’s investment in key growth regions across South East Asia. The post La Vie expands international footprint appeared first on Hotel Management.

item.title: Trilogy upswing with third-party management continues
item.description: Trilogy Hotels has commenced management of Peppers Gallery Hotel Canberra, with the transition marking the group’s continued expansion following “positive momentum in the market.” The post Trilogy upswing with third-party management continues appeared first on Hotel Management.

item.title: Outrigger takes first Green Keys in South Pacific
item.description: Outrigger Resorts & Hotels’ Fiji properties have been recognised for their sustainability efforts with Green Key Certification – the first in Fiji. The post Outrigger takes first Green Keys in South Pacific appeared first on Hotel Management.

item.title: Exclusive: inside the architecturally striking Observatory Hotel in Christchurch

item.title: Milestone celebration for Mount Lofty House

item.title: Conversion: IHG’s Voco to rise in Queenstown
